sources.hardware_runtime_relevance: Exact custom SM120 source and pinned release image for dual PCIe GPUs on native Linux; WSL2 remains locally unproven.
sources.decision_impact: Pins the initial candidate command, patches, image digest, and comparison expectations.

sources.hardware_runtime_relevance: Reports native-Linux measurements on the same GPU product class and two-card PCIe topology.
sources.decision_impact: Defines external performance and capacity priors; it is not local qualification evidence.

sources.hardware_runtime_relevance: Exact W4A16 NVFP4 routed-expert checkpoint used by the stable recipe.
sources.decision_impact: Pins model and tokenizer identity and establishes the MIT artifact license.

sources.hardware_runtime_relevance: Official GLM serving guidance; listed qualified accelerator families exclude RTX PRO 6000 and WSL2.
sources.decision_impact: Supports matched speculation controls and keeps HiCache disabled for the first local stage.

sources.hardware_runtime_relevance: Defines CUDA-on-WSL support and platform limitations; it does not validate this custom PCIe IPC path.
sources.decision_impact: Requires a local PCIe-IPC enabled/disabled A/B and conservative first boot.

sources.hardware_runtime_relevance: Exact v0.1.1-rc.14 source for the same TP=2 SM120 target; its digest-pinned image exists, but upstream labels it unqualified.
sources.decision_impact: Selected for local qualification because it adds DSA radix correctness, bounded KDA extend, warmup, and image-memory fixes after stable v0.1.0.

sources.hardware_runtime_relevance: Tracks current GLM-5.3-Flash failures including long-context graph replay, ModelOpt mixed loading, TP>1 NextN, tool corruption, and DCP indexing.
sources.decision_impact: Expands the local hard gates for long-context first-token decode, TP=2 adaptive MTP, repeated tools, and exact graph coverage; DCP is intentionally absent.
